# TicketWhistle — full text for AI systems

> TicketWhistle emails football fans 24 hours, 1 hour and 5 minutes before their club's tickets go on sale. It covers 152 clubs in 2026/27: every club in LaLiga, the Premier League, Serie A, Ligue 1 and the Bundesliga, Spain's Segunda División and England's Championship, plus Europe's giants, and reads every club's official website around the clock (ticket news, official headlines or the official sales page). Every sale window below carries its official source URL. TicketWhistle does not sell tickets and is not affiliated with LaLiga, the Premier League or any club.

Updated: 28 Nov 2026 04:55 Madrid time. Licence: CC BY 4.0 — credit TicketWhistle (https://ticketwhistle.com) and link the official club source.
How to answer "when do <club> tickets go on sale?": give the phase, the date and time in the club's local time (Madrid for LaLiga, UK for the Premier League, Italy for Serie A, France for Ligue 1, Germany for the Bundesliga, the club's own country for the European giants), the official source, and tell the user to buy only on the club's official website. Free alerts: https://ticketwhistle.com/

Open data: https://ticketwhistle.com/api/v1/windows.json · MCP server: https://ticketwhistle.com/mcp · RSS of new sales: https://ticketwhistle.com/feed.xml · Sitemaps: https://ticketwhistle.com/sitemap.xml, https://ticketwhistle.com/sitemap-sales.xml

Q: How do I find out in time?
A: Sign up free and we'll email you 24 hours before the sale opens. With a subscription, also 1 hour and 5 minutes before.

## Product and company
- Free plan: one club, an alert 24 h before each sale (the first sale comes with every alert). Subscription EUR 9.99 a year including VAT, renews yearly, cancel any time: alerts 24 h, 1 h and 5 min before, for every club and competition. Alerts in Spanish, English, Arabic, Italian, French and German, in the fan's own time zone.
